title: History 6: Denoising diffusion arrives (DDPM, 2020)
hook: The DDPM paper checked against exact answers: the posterior of a forward step, the weights the simplified loss drops, and why the two reverse variances barely differ. Plus which one ComfyUI's ddpm sampler uses.

verified.claim: The mean is eq. 11, and alpha comes from sigma. The noise term has variance (1 − α)(1 − ᾱ_prev)/(1 − ᾱ), and it is added only when sigma_prev is above 0.
ddpm is in the sampler list.
Both branches read, with defaults 1e-4 and 2e-2.
The posterior, eq. 12, the weights and the reverse variances print as shown.
